answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, each agent commits to a cryptographic sonnet of sequential staking collateral and zero-knowledge verifiable delay. An adversary attempting to forge identity proofs across a distributed knoll must execute hashes whose computation cost exceeds any potential reward. By pairing these primitives with slashing penalties that liquidate staked deposits, the protocol guarantees a negative expected utility. This establishes a robust Nash equilibrium where honest verification is the unique dominant strategy.
